mathematical_assumptions: Each fixed-resource Store is noncyclic, initially Q, lossless and nonnegative; discharge-only.
Resource Bus has Store and exclusive meter; meter efficiency=1. Destination Bus has only group meters and fixed approved Load.
Annual weighted sum of exact equalities gives sum(e_T)=sum(Q)-D=Sg; nonnegative stock then 0<=e_iT<=Sg.
For an approximate returned point, positive and negative inventory may cancel. The exact implication cannot excuse negative stocks or distributed numerical leakage.
theorem_scope: Terminal/annual proximity is a consequence in this frozen isolated group; Q remains a cap, not a new general mandatory-use scientific definition. No standalone e_T=0 constraint is invented.
endpoint_tests: PASS equality/fixed arbitrary-sign multiplier; upper-only negative multiplier; free zero multiplier; free nonzero RC rejection
